scenarios.invariant: An Actual Start correction atomically updates Orders, Scheduling, Client Finance, Payroll, lifecycle and their source outboxes exactly once.
assertions: a complete service-time root is required before correction
replaying the same command returns the original receipt
Orders, Scheduling, Client Finance and Payroll versions each advance once
one Actual Start event, one receipt and one source outbox event per affected Domain are persisted
the real Streamlit panel sends the corrected date through typed HTTP Preview and Apply with production-like request-scoped dependencies

scenarios.invariant: A safe Terms change rebuilds Scheduling, Client Finance, Payroll and lifecycle in one Orders transaction without duplicate delivery. Terms Apply does not directly create an anomaly; a post-rebuild Scheduling coverage scan owns any actual coverage alert.
assertions: the canonical workflow no longer contains a source-recovery stub
one Apply advances Orders, Scheduling, Client Finance and Payroll once
one source outbox event exists for Orders, Client Finance and Payroll
replaying the same idempotency key returns the original receipt without new writes
the real Streamlit panel sends the safe terms change through typed HTTP Preview and Apply
a service-day-count change without an approved assignment reallocation plan fails closed rather than synthesizing an unsafe assignment
Terms Apply writes no direct anomaly; post-rebuild coverage risk remains owned by the Scheduling coverage scan

scenarios.invariant: A mid-service two-caregiver cancellation atomically updates Orders, Scheduling, Client Finance, Payroll and their source outboxes exactly once, without netting client refunds against staff payables.
assertions: replaying the same command returns the original receipt
the original two assignments are replaced by one cancellation generation
Orders, Scheduling, Client Finance and Payroll versions each advance once
Orders, Client Finance and Payroll each append one source outbox event
a pre-paid client receives separate 1600 and 200 refund payables while the old unpaid staff obligations close and two new 2500 staff payables are created
the real Streamlit panel sends only the actually completed service days through typed HTTP Preview and Apply before the canonical cross-domain cancellation commits

scenarios.invariant: A completed order with established full-service staff pay is rejected before any cancellation write, leaving staff payroll unchanged.
assertions: the explicit order_cancellation_after_full_service blocker is returned
cancellation, finance, payroll and Orders outbox write counts remain unchanged
the existing payroll account version and both established staff obligations remain byte-for-byte equivalent

scenarios.invariant: AutoComplete and the real Leave/Substitution Apply serialize on the same Orders lifecycle aggregate; the stale command writes nothing and a changed official service day requires a recomputed completion instant.
assertions: AutoComplete first appends exactly one Orders lifecycle event, source outbox event and auto-completion receipt, without Scheduling, Client Finance or Payroll writes
the true stale Leave Apply returns stale_version and leaves every captured Scheduling, Client Finance, Payroll, Orders outbox and leave outcome count unchanged
Leave first advances its official service-day and Orders lifecycle versions through the real workflow; the old completion returns order_version_conflict with no writes
a recomputed completion is blocked before the new completion instant and succeeds exactly once at that instant

scenarios.invariant: An ordinary Finance Import review row enters finance once and does not duplicate IMPORT-006.
assertions: replaying the same ingestion key returns the same receipt
only one Finance Import outbox event is present
the sole current alert is active finance_import_manual_review, not IMPORT-006

scenarios.invariant: A paused or recovered anomaly projector does not alter committed Domain facts.
assertions: injected projector failure marks the Finance Import outbox event failed
committed refund ledger and settled payable remain unchanged while projection is paused
recovered projector delivers the event without changing those Domain facts

scenarios.invariant: A correction/post failure rolls back classification, ledger, allocation, receipt and alert resolution; retry is exact.
assertions: injected owning-domain failure leaves only the original classification event
no client ledger, allocation, correction receipt or resolved alert is persisted
retry with the same idempotency key writes exactly one ledger, correction receipt and manual classification

scenarios.invariant: Concurrent Leave/Substitution and Orders cancellation scheduling rebuilds for the same caregivers serialize through the canonical staff mutex; the later stale command returns a typed error without deadlock or duplicate same-caregiver, same-day occupancy.
assertions: two real workflows begin from separate Previews against the same in-service two-caregiver order
exactly one Apply succeeds and the other returns a typed workflow error
both threads finish before the timeout, proving no deadlock
exactly one effective Scheduling generation remains
no staff/date group in scheduling_effective_occupancy contains more than one row

scenarios.invariant: A canonical deposit reversal reopens only the Client Finance deposit obligation; a later immutable Finance Import receipt reconciliation re-settles it and activates Orders actual-start reconfirmation without a legacy payment write.
assertions: the reversal appends one immutable Client Finance ledger entry and one obligation event
the deposit projection changes from settled to unsettled without writing client_payments
the same original Apply payload replays without additional writes
a pre-service reversal emits orders_deposit_reversed only
a post-service reversal does not change the Order status and also emits anomaly_review_required
a later immutable classified receipt runs the real Client Receipt workflow, re-settles the canonical projection and activates Orders reconfirmation without writing client_payments
the real Streamlit deposit-reversal panel sends Preview and Apply through the typed HTTP router and creates the canonical reversal without a legacy client_payments write

scenarios.invariant: A durable worker crash, lease recovery, duplicate delivery and notification loss cannot duplicate a command.
assertions: a first worker claims the persisted command then exits before domain execution
an expired lease is recovered by a second worker with the same command identity
the Finance Import Apply receipt is persisted once and a later worker poll claims nothing
the persisted job receipt remains readable without a notification channel

scenarios.invariant: Client Finance refund and reversal never remove or rewrite an Orders service-data lock.
assertions: lock snapshot is unchanged after refund
lock snapshot is unchanged after reversal

scenarios.invariant: A lost Finance Import API response retried with the same idempotency key persists and applies exactly one cross-domain command.
assertions: the first response is intentionally discarded before the client retry
both API calls with the same key leave one durable background job
the independent worker applies the Finance Import batch once and a later poll claims nothing
exactly one Finance Import Apply receipt is committed

scenarios.invariant: Every Finance Import manual-correction persistence seam rolls back the entire cross-domain transaction.
assertions: injected faults cover classification, post-after-owning-Domain-ledger, reconciliation receipt, alert resolve, outbox, batch version and correction receipt
each fault leaves no client ledger or allocation, correction receipt, manual-correction outbox, resolved alert, new classification event or version advance
all runs use dedicated disposable lu_test_g08_* MySQL schemas

scenarios.invariant: The Finance Import Streamlit panel projects the same typed Preview as the direct application and has no UI business fallback.
assertions: a real Taishin workbook travels through the panel helper, UI client and real HTTP router
the direct typed application returns the same version, fingerprint, apply state, blockers, counts and row identities
the panel stores the server response without deriving a separate Preview

scenarios.invariant: The Finance Import panel shows pending until its durable job succeeds and retries a lost response with the same command identity.
assertions: the first Apply reaches the real API but its response is deliberately lost
the panel retries with the same idempotency key and receives the original job
the jobs API reports queued before an independent worker runs
the panel reports success only after the worker stores a succeeded receipt

scenarios.invariant: Cache is confined to non-authoritative read projections. Formal command workflows read fresh locked facts without a cache dependency, and an Apply from a stale Preview returns a typed conflict without writes.
assertions: every subsystem workflow source is free of QueryCachePort and TtlProjectionCache dependencies
the only TTL cache is the read-only holiday projection and has no transaction control
a real stale Leave Apply after AutoComplete returns stale_version
the stale Apply leaves captured Scheduling, Client Finance, Payroll, Orders outbox and leave outcome counts unchanged
